interaction_fields.input_format: Needs verification per tool source; controls vary between text, numeric/date fields, and file uploads.
interaction_fields.output_format: Needs verification per tool source; some tools return text, some generate/download files, and some show previews.
interaction_fields.supported_file_formats: Needs verification per tool source; inspect input accept attributes and runtime validation.

technical_findings.finding: Dynamic sitemap output is invalid XML under local PHP CLI execution.
Sitemap sources are inconsistent and omit route families; static XML has 123 URLs, HTML snapshot states 114 pages, and dynamic generator omits guides/aliases.
Ten legacy comparison aliases can use distinct self-canonicals for identical content.
Default Open Graph/Twitter image path does not exist in workspace.
ConvertAPI secrets are exposed in client-delivered scripts; server-side PDF-to-Word source also disables TLS verification.
Contact form action targets a file not present in workspace; word-to-PDF API file is empty.
robots.txt has duplicate wildcard groups and duplicate sitemap directives.

content_findings.finding: 74 tool view routes are not in category-data.php; category pages and search.php use that registry.
Seven tool view pages do not include their matching long-form content file; only 46 matching fragments have FAQ markup.
Privacy/About/llms.txt claims need reconciliation with external and server-side conversion flows and analytics/ads scripts.
Page descriptions for legal/info views still refer to Snapy Tools rather than WordsCompare.
Tool SEO related-guide resolver checks the wrong content path/name pattern for public guide routes.
PDF-to-CSV output route and PDF-to-Word output settings need reconciliation with actual converter request behavior.
The /guides index links to four hubs but does not enumerate all 10 article routes.

internal_link_findings.finding: Category and search links come from the 49 distinct registered tool slugs; 74 tool files are omitted from those surfaces.
internal_link_findings.status: Verified from registry and file counts

internal_link_findings.finding: Related guide links likely fail because helper looks for views/content/{slug}.php while guide routes are views/guides/{slug}.php and tool fragments use -content.php.

Full orphan and broken-link classification needs rendered crawl/status checks.
